notes.title: 1.2 Patch Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34506730/6725bfce6247ef71f4791785fb519696a49b2ed5.jpg[/img]

- We polished English localization, all texts localised by native speaker.

- Added full Russian localization.

- Added new feature AUTOFIRE, it’s enabled by default. It means your ships will automatically fire at the nearest enemy. You can manually designate targets when you have a ship selected. This will engage manual targeting mode, and you must set targets for each ship to fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34506730/9f89d1a065df76d235a69ba640bf06db4604d0bb.jpg[/img]

- In quests you can use hotkeys on the top of you keyboard (1-9) to choose the dialog options. 

- DPS of all weapons increased by 10%.

- HP and SP of enemy ships balanced.

- Art changes in "Order popup" and Galaxy map.

- Art fixes in UI and popups.

- Added music looping in Main Menu.

- Fixed bug when sound settings cannot be saved.

- Fixed bug when you sell support ship and items disappear.

- Fixed bug when you buy support ship with 3 module slots and all items from Flagship are cloned to this support ship.

- Fixed font blurring.

- Items descriptions now is divided by effect and features.

- When enemy fleet ask of mercy, now you can receive not only goods, by random your ship can be damaged.

- Now settings menu and "alert popup" in Main Menu can be closed by clicking Esc buttons in keyboard.

- Now when you finish the game all saves will be deleted, and you can’t return to the last sector.

- Fixed news sound in some news in the store.

- Added all “Crucible” variants to the shop. Damages of player version are nerfed.

- Rebalanced missile module "BREAKDOWN Missile Launcher".

- Final boss fight rebalanced.

- Fixed double clicking bug on some buttons.

- Fixed support ship in tutorial when they can be without turrets.

- Fixed quest bugs.

We recommend to start a new game so that all changes take effect.
Thank you!

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Released
notes.content:
Good news everyone)
It is time for a first Star Souls patch. It includes:

- Update of final quests in each sector: we added 8 small animated movies. Hope you'll like it)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34506730/c3647e7006191efd733115b1a0dde3111e19fd58.gif[/img]

- English texts correction in 1-2 sector by native speaker. We are still in progress, so wait for future updates.
- Minor bugs fixes and refinement of text events.

- Star Souls 32 achievements are available in Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34506730/6823de4a551e75df78b8c885b8c26b70ceedead6.jpg[/img]

- Improved and revised Tutorial.
- Small bugs and balance fixes.

Thank you for your patience and loyalty!
